text:
Type: rectangular planter on wooden feet
Use: growing herbs or plants on a windowsill, a shelf or a sideboard; living room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: white coated metal box, small bamboo feet
Colors: white, light natural bamboo
Shape: long tapered trough with straight sides, raised on two small blocky wooden stands, clean and light, medium length
Feel: fresh, tidy, light, natural
Goes with: herbs and green plants, light wood, white walls, linen; Scandinavian or Japandi kitchens and living rooms
